verdict.rationale: Datalab documents no region or residency selector for its hosted API. Its own Enterprise on-prem offering lets customers run its models on infrastructure they control, with a container, a Helm chart and air-gapped deployment, which gives data-location control but only through a self-hosted Enterprise contract. Missing for 10: hosted-cloud region/residency selection, documentation of where hosted data is stored, and availability below the Enterprise tier.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Customers can run our models on infrastructure they control with an Enterprise contract.
Enterprise adds running on your own infrastructure (air-gapped) with SSO.
A Helm chart is available for deploying the container on Kubernetes clusters.
